question: The neighbouring countries Peru and Chile are located in which continent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Peru** and **Chile** are located in **South America**, which is one of the seven continents on Earth.
 
• **South America** is situated entirely in the Western Hemisphere and mostly in the Southern Hemisphere. It is bordered by the Pacific Ocean to the west and the Atlantic Ocean to the east.
 
• Both **Peru** and **Chile** are coastal countries in South America, sharing a long coastline along the Pacific Ocean.
